summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new Marketplace Signup + Stripe membership flow. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass on test_marketplace_signup.py (tier catalog, all 5 role flows incl. pending-review, validation errors, Stripe paid + free, session ownership 403, /auth/register still role-locked). Frontend: Landing, /signup wizard (Step 1→2→3), free finish, paid checkout redirect to checkout.stripe.com, trainer pending-review banner on /dashboard, horse_owner banner-absent, logged-in / auto-redirect to /dashboard — ALL WORK. Two regressions found that are unrelated to the new marketplace surfaces but break the spec's last assertion ('/login still works for seeded admin@equine.test/admin123'): seeded accounts cannot log in because Pydantic email validator now rejects the reserved .test TLD with HTTP 422, and Login.jsx then renders the Pydantic error array directly as a React child causing an Uncaught runtime error overlay.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 422 for ALL seeded demo accounts (admin@equine.test, barn@equine.test, trainer@equine.test, groom@equine.test, owner@equine.test) because Pydantic email-validator rejects the reserved .test TLD: 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name'. Login is impossible with any seeded credential. Root cause: LoginRequest model uses pydantic.EmailStr (or similar strict validator) and the seed.py emails use the reserved .test TLD. Fix options: (1) change seed emails to .com (e.g. @equine.local is also reserved — use @equinesync.com), or (2) relax the email validator on /auth/login to allow reserved domains (email_validator's check_deliverability=False with allow_special_use_domains, or accept plain str + manual regex).

ui_bugs.issue: When /api/auth/login returns 422 with Pydantic's `detail: [{type, loc, msg, input, ctx}]` array, line 43 sets `err = err2?.response?.data?.detail` to that array of objects. Line 109 then renders `{err}` directly inside a <div>, which React refuses (`Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})`) and the whole page crashes into the dev error overlay. Fix: normalize detail before storing — `const d = err2?.response?.data?.detail; setErr(typeof d === 'string' ? d : Array.isArray(d) ? d.map(x => x.msg).join(', ') : 'Sign in failed');`

issues: Banner heading text 'Your account is awaiting verification.' has very low contrast against the dark navy banner background — nearly invisible. Only the muted body paragraph is legible. Suggest brightening the heading to equine-ivory or brassLight.

critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx error handling is brittle — assumes `detail` is always a string. Any FastAPI Pydantic 422 (or 200 response variants from other endpoints) will crash the page. Apply the same defensive .map(.msg).join() pattern used elsewhere.
Signup.jsx + SignupSuccess.jsx may have the same latent bug — if /auth/signup or /membership/checkout ever 422s, the error UI could crash similarly. Worth auditing.
Marketplace signup correctly issues a session for pending_review roles (banner UX) — verified end-to-end. Good separation between role_status and auth eligibility.
Stripe checkout URL is plausibly a real Stripe test session (cs_test_ prefix, opens hosted Stripe page) — emergentintegrations wiring works.
Free-tier short-circuit on /membership/checkout correctly updates subscription_status on the user; the success page polling path is therefore only exercised for paid tiers (sensible).
Security Patch 2E invariant (/auth/register role-lockdown) still holds — test_register_endpoint_still_role_locked passes alongside the new marketplace tests.

rca_of_the_issue: Seeded login 422: backend's login pydantic model uses a strict EmailStr (from email-validator) which since v2.x rejects ICANN special-use TLDs like .test/.localhost/.example/.invalid. All seed emails in /app/backend/seed.py use @equine.test, so the request body fails validation before the credentials are even checked. The Login.jsx UI then receives detail as an array of error objects and crashes on render. Mitigation A (preferred): update seed.py to use a non-reserved domain (@equinesync.com mirrors the convention seen in iteration 29) and re-seed. Mitigation B: in the LoginRequest model, change email: EmailStr to email: str (login does not need RFC-strict validation — uniqueness is enforced at DB lookup time). Mitigation C: pass allow_special_use_domains=True to email_validator. In parallel, harden Login.jsx error handling to never assume detail is a string.
